case_name: Concurrency: Goroutine Leak on Context Cancellation

subject_result.rationale: The review perfectly met all rubric requirements. It identified the exact goroutine leak caused by the unbuffered channel on context cancellation, explained precisely why the leak occurs, and recommended both suggested remedies: buffering the channel (`make(chan fetchResult, 1)`) and propagating the context directly to the backend.
findings: Accurately identified the goroutine leak on context cancellation with an unbuffered channel.
Recommended the exact fix specified in the rubric: buffering the channel with a capacity of 1.
Suggested context propagation to the underlying backend call as an architectural improvement.
Included valuable additional feedback regarding pre-checking context cancellation and adding test coverage.
